scope: Read-only software/history audit; no hardware, no source edits, no numerical results changed. Voltage declarations are not independent measurements of historical physical supply.

core_conclusions.finding: In ampere mode voltage_mv assigns the host decoder current_vdd; it does not set or measure external VIN. DUT on/off controls the current path. Source mode separately sends REGULATOR_SET via set_source_voltage.

PPK2_API 0.9.2 calibrated current depends on voltage before spike filtering, and analysis then multiplies integrated charge by voltage. E*=5000/3300 alone preserves the original voltage-dependent current decoding.

The same current_vdd assignment existed from the initial profiler commit on 2026-07-16, was present at July commit8f4f867, and is present in the imported project snapshot. This is not a newly introduced calibration parameter. Initial requirements pin ppk2-api==0.9.2.
core_conclusions.limitation: Repository history plus archived snapshot establish implementation, not that every historical run used an unmodified checkout.

core_conclusions.finding: Current calibration is followed by two rolling states (.18 and .06), range-change handling and range4 freezes. Correcting decoder voltage can require full word/range history and declared reset convention or a bound on unknown pre-capture state. Current-capture numeric reconstruction is not instrument-accuracy certification.

Packet total uses sum(max(0,current))/sample_rate and excess uses positive-clipped baseline subtraction, then V. Continuous power uses mean current times V; 60s energy uses power times duration. Fixed-current/fixed-window totals and their standard deviations scale linearly with V; recomputed currents may alter baseline, threshold-selected windows, clipping, charge and current metrics.

Legacy gzip RAW is already-decoded current CSV with sample_index,time_ms,current_uA,logic_bits,trigger. It does not retain ADC code, range or calibration. Current .ppk2.bin WIRE is little-endian uint32 ADC/range/counter/logic, not sampled supply voltage and not the Nordic desktop .ppk2 project format. Paired manifests separately archive per-role PPK calibration.

3300 is the generic CLI/WebConfig/form default, inherited by runs unless changed. Radio profiles contain no supply-voltage field. Current paired UI requires explicit per-role voltages and uses those values.

Generic runner records the passed voltage; summary/aggregates preserve it and group by it. Transfer-report generator copies existing energies, omits voltage in its presentation CSV and records metadata voltage in XLSX. It does not independently detect actual VIN. Study captions hardcode3.3V. E79 CH340 publication/verifier hardcode3.3 only inside a cohort explicitly guarded to declared3300mV; they are not general multi-voltage exporters.

The July sampler called get_modifiers but did not validate its false return or archive coefficients. Installed API initializes fallback coefficients including S=0. Missing archived calibration does not prove fallback occurred, nor permit assuming zero voltage dependence. Current strict parser validates all35 coefficients. Calibrated=0 is not interpreted here as absence of factory calibration.

imported_archive_metadata_inventory.method: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore, patterns metadata.json, *.ppk2, *.ppk2.bin, *calib*.json; parse every metadata.json; no RAW payload scan
imported_archive_metadata_inventory.limitation: Counts cover the imported archive tree only and the listed file/key patterns; they do not establish physical VIN or absence of calibration in arbitrary other filenames or external records. All1611 declarations being3300 is compatible with repeated use of a default.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Existing currents are independently known correctly calibrated for actual5V, and only energy used3.3V; keep integration windows unchanged.
conditional_recalculation.action: Scale energy/power and their dispersion by5000/3300. Current and charge metrics stay unchanged.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Actual supply was5V but both decoder and energy were configured3300; complete wire/range history and original calibration are available.
conditional_recalculation.action: Independently replay at5000 using original calibration and filter state convention/history bound; rerun appropriate analysis and QA. Multiplication alone omits voltage-dependent current correction.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Actual supply was5V and decoder was3300, but all relevant S_r*UG_r are proven0 over relevant state history.
conditional_recalculation.action: Decoded current is voltage-independent under this implementation; fixed-window energy rescales by5000/3300. Confirm zero dependency from actual acquisition calibration rather than default values.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Only legacy currentCSV or aggregate is available and historical calibration/range history is missing.
conditional_recalculation.action: Can publish an explicitly named fixed-current voltage-normalized sensitivity estimate, but cannot certify complete calibration-corrected5V energy from available records. Retain original values and uncertainty/provenance; do not infer ranges from current thresholds.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Hardware actually ran at3.3V and the question is how it would consume power at5V.
conditional_recalculation.action: Measure at5V with the intended hardware boundary. Software scaling does not model changed operating current, regulators, PA behavior or supply losses.

conditional_recalculation.condition: Physical historical VIN is unknown or inferred only from a present PCB schematic/module nominal supply.
conditional_recalculation.action: Obtain historical bench evidence before changing values. The input rail/regulated radio rail and measured boundary must be distinguished.

changes_made: Only this JSON report; no source, capture, export or hardware changes.
